第1章绑定女友朱竹清，我不该看的都看到了-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》

斗罗大陆，星斗大森林。

浑身鲜血，伤痕累累的叶寒，斩杀了十几只十年或百年修为的疾风狼，拖着一把血色长剑，眼神冷漠坚定地向森林深处缓慢走去。

曾经，他是擅长使用冷兵器的国际顶尖杀手，代号“夜王”，在执行一次神秘任务时，突然穿越到了这里。

手中血色长剑和袖中匕首就是随他一起穿越而来的兵器。

在这里，他待了不知多少日夜，几乎每天都在与凶猛的野兽搏杀。

如今，他身受重伤，油尽灯枯，只想找个安静的地方长眠。

不知不觉中，他来到了一片清澈的湖畔。

此时，一位容颜绝世，身材性感的美女正在湖水中沐浴。

这是他第一次在这里看到人类。

就在他准备发声求救时，美女也发现了他，眼神中闪过一丝寒意。

随后，美女钻进了湖水中，消失不见了。

叶寒再也坚持不住疲惫的身躯，倒在地面上，昏沉沉的意识，让他感觉到了死亡的降临。

【叮！恭喜宿主邂逅女神朱竹清，激活家族系统。】

【系统设定一：创建家族：宿主每收录一名家族成员，便能获得丰厚奖励，宿主的资质、修为、体魄、魂环、魂骨、血脉等属性也会收到反馈，无限增强。例如收录女友、妻子、义妹、义姐、小弟、义子、义女、奴隶、兽宠等。】

【系统设定二：家族贡献：家族成员收录成功后，会被系统绑定，开启家族贡献模式，觉醒一种神位传承，只要家族成员为家族做出贡献，就能获得贡献值，与宿主共享神位。】

【系统设定三：多子多福：主角的孩子越多，为家族添砖加瓦，家族传承就越兴旺，获得的奖励越丰富。】

【注：随着家族成员的增加，宿主就能打造出神级家族，成为众神之主。】

【叮！由于宿主穿越之前是杀手身份，特奖励杀神模板，奖励杀神九式。】

【叮！鉴于宿主还未创建家族，特给予一次强行绑定家族成员的机会，请问宿主是否绑定朱竹清。】

“绑定！”

叶寒听着冰冷的提示声，下意识地做出了决定，便彻底晕厥了过去，失去了意识。

这时候，朱竹清已经穿好衣物，急速纵跃而来。

此人敢偷看她沐浴，必挖双眼。

【叮！朱竹清绑定成功，奖励火眼金睛，获得速度之神（二级神祇）传承。】

【注：速度之神传承处于未觉醒状态，需要朱竹清提升家族贡献值才能激活，当朱竹清的贡献值达到一百，就能获得神位传承，百级成神，为宿主增加一个神位掌控权。】

【叮！创建家族需要为朱竹清确定一种家族身份，请问宿主如何定位她的身份，例如女友、妻子、义妹、义姐、义女等。】

【叮！还请宿主回答，否则系统将会自动做出选择。】

【叮！宿主长时间未答复，系统自动选择女友身份，从此，朱竹清将会以宿主女友的身份共处，希望宿主能够早日拿下朱竹清，让她成为妻子，为你传宗接代，多造娃。】

【注：由于朱竹清的女友身份是系统强行介入，需要时间激活，快速培养感情。】

系统提示声在叶寒的脑海中传来，磅礴的能量在改善他的身体。

他手上的血色长剑和袖中匕首也在此刻变成一抹亮芒，没入他的体内，成为他的武魂。

但已经晕死过去的叶寒，根本就不知道发生了什么。

此时，朱竹清已经来到他的身旁。

浓厚的血腥味，让她有点反胃。

朱竹清见他好像没有气息了，踢了踢他的脚底，冷声喊道：“喂，起来，别想碰瓷装死。”

朱竹清见他还是没有任何反应，眉头微微一皱，淡定地摸了摸他的脖子。

发现还有脉搏，有救。

想必刚才应该是个误会。

当她扯开叶寒衣服，打算施救时，发现他身上满是伤口，密密麻麻的，可怕至极。

有还在渗血的十几道新伤口，也有已经结巴的旧伤口，加起来足足有上百道。

尤其是胸前和腹部那几道伤口最严重，都能看到里面的骨头和肠子。

“天呢，他到底经历了什么？”

Douluo Continent, Star Dou Forest.

Ye Han, who was covered in blood and scarred, killed a dozen wind wolves that had cultivated for ten or a hundred years. He dragged a bloody sword and walked slowly deep into the forest with cold and firm eyes.

Once upon a time, he was a top international killer who was good at using cold weapons, codenamed "Night King". While performing a mysterious mission, he suddenly traveled here.

The bloody sword in his hand and the dagger in his sleeve are the weapons that traveled through time with him.

He stayed here for countless days and nights, fighting ferocious beasts almost every day.

Now, he was seriously injured, his energy was exhausted, and he just wanted to find a quiet place to sleep.

Unknowingly, he came to a clear lake.

At this time, a beautiful woman with stunning appearance and sexy figure was bathing in the lake.

This was the first time he'd seen a human here.

Just when he was about to cry out for help, the beauty also noticed him, with a chill flashing in her eyes.

Then, the beauty got into the lake and disappeared.

Ye Han could no longer hold on to his tired body and fell to the ground. His groggy consciousness made him feel the approach of death.

【bite!Congratulations to the host for meeting the goddess Zhu Zhuqing and activating the family system.】

[System setting 1: Create a family: Every time the host recruits a family member, he will receive generous rewards. The host's qualifications, cultivation, body, soul ring, soul bone, bloodline and other attributes will also receive feedback and be infinitely enhanced.For example, it includes girlfriend, wife, adopted sister, adopted sister, younger brother, adopted son, adopted daughter, slave, pet, etc.】

[System Setting 2: Family Contribution: After the family members are successfully included, they will be bound to the system, turn on the family contribution mode, and awaken a divine inheritance. As long as family members contribute to the family, they can obtain contribution points and share the divine throne with the host.】

[System Setting 3: Many Children, More Blessings: The more children the protagonist has and contributes to the family, the more prosperous the family inheritance will be, and the richer the rewards will be.】

[Note: As the family members increase, the host can create a god-level family and become the master of the gods.】

[Ding!Since the host was a killer before traveling through time, he is specially rewarded with the God of Killing template and the Nine Styles of the God of Killing.】

[Ding!Since the host has not yet created a family, we are given a chance to forcibly bind family members. Please ask the host if he will bind Zhu Zhuqing.】

"Bind!"

Ye Han listened to the cold reminder and made a decision subconsciously, then completely fainted and lost consciousness.

At this time, Zhu Zhuqing had already put on his clothes and jumped over quickly.

If anyone dares to peek at her bathing, his eyes will be gouged out.

【bite!Zhu Zhuqing was successfully bound, and was rewarded with fiery eyes and golden eyes, and obtained the inheritance of the God of Speed ​​(second-level god).】

[Note: The inheritance of the God of Speed is in an unawakened state and requires Zhu Zhuqing to increase his family's contribution value to activate it. When Zhu Zhuqing's contribution value reaches 100, he can obtain the inheritance of the god status and become a god at level 100, adding control of a god status to the host.】

[Ding!Creating a family requires determining a family identity for Zhu Zhuqing. Please ask the host how to position her identity, such as girlfriend, wife, adopted sister, adopted sister, adopted daughter, etc.】

[Ding!Also ask the host to answer, otherwise the system will automatically make the selection.】

[Ding!The host did not reply for a long time, and the system automatically selected the girlfriend's identity. From now on, Zhu Zhuqing will live with the host's girlfriend. I hope the host can get Zhu Zhuqing as soon as possible and make her your wife to carry on your family line and have more children.】

[Note: Since the identity of Zhu Zhuqing’s girlfriend is forced by the system, it takes time to activate and quickly develop feelings.】

The system prompt sounded in Ye Han's mind, and the majestic energy was improving his body.

The bloody sword in his hand and the dagger in his sleeve also turned into a flash of light at this moment, sinking into his body and becoming his martial spirit.

But Ye Han, who had fainted, had no idea what was happening.

At this time, Zhu Zhuqing had already arrived beside him.

The strong smell of blood made her a little nauseous.

Seeing that he seemed to have no breath, Zhu Zhuqing kicked the soles of his feet and shouted coldly: "Hey, get up, don't try to pretend to be dead."

Seeing that he still had no reaction, Zhu Zhuqing frowned slightly and touched his neck calmly.

It was found that he still had a pulse, so he could be saved.

It must have been a misunderstanding just now.

When she tore off Ye Han's clothes and tried to rescue him, she found that his body was covered with wounds, which were densely packed and terrifying.

There are more than a dozen new wounds that are still bleeding, and there are also old wounds that have stuttered. In total, there are hundreds of them.

Especially the wounds on the chest and abdomen were the most serious, and the bones and intestines inside could be seen.

"Oh my god, what has he been through?"
